mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 shows a sustained increase over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over a month signals a supply shock, which increases costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and increases corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 over a month signals economic weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI increases by more than 0.3% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, which increases borrowing costs and erodes real earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and housing starts increase by more than 3% over two months, it signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive and HOUST increases > 3% in 2 months
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 is positive and HOUST increases by more than 3% over two months.
